asset_policy: append-only content-addressed work files; never delete raw captures, cue audio, subtitles, segments, or prior takes

chapters.title_zh: 欢迎来到天朝大厂：你的封地，也有绩效季
chapters.title_en: WELCOME TO THE IMPERIAL MEGACORP: YOUR FIEF HAS REVIEW SEASON
body_en: Gameplay opens on the feature, never CK3 loading

cues.zh: 如果你以为当上公爵，工作就是喝茶、联姻、等继承，那只能说明你还没收到本季度绩效通知。
cues.en: If you thought becoming a duke meant tea, marriage, and waiting for inheritance, you clearly have not received this quarter's review notice.

cues.zh: 这里是《天朝特色361制官员绩效考核》：把互联网大厂最熟悉的焦虑，塞进最适合背锅的封建官场。
cues.en: This is ZhongGuo 361 Style: familiar megacorp anxiety, translated into the feudal bureaucracy best equipped to pass the blame.

cues.zh: 没有启动器，没有读条，没有先看三十秒地图发呆。镜头一开，直接问你：今年这个C，准备让谁背？
cues.en: No launcher and no loading screen. We open on the only question that matters: who is carrying this year's bottom rating?

chapters.title_zh: 谁给谁打分：公爵以上都是经理，伯爵男爵只能被卷
chapters.title_en: WHO RATES WHOM: DUKES AND ABOVE MANAGE; COUNTS AND BARONS GET MANAGED

capture.shot: 打开一名天朝制公爵角色页与直属封臣列表；切到伯爵角色，展示前者可主持考核、后者只有被考核告身。

cues.zh: 规则先说清：所有天朝制公爵及以上领主，都要给自己的直属官员做考核，不只皇帝。
cues.en: First, the reporting line: every celestial-government duke or higher rates their own direct officials, not just the emperor.

cues.zh: 伯爵和男爵也别高兴太早。他们不能考核别人，但会被上司考核；没有打分权，不代表没有被打分权。
cues.en: Counts and barons cannot rate anyone, but their superior still rates them. No management authority does not mean freedom from management.

cues.zh: 于是玩家既可能是台上念名单的领导，也可能下一秒收到上司告身：您好，您今年符合预期，意思是别想涨薪。
cues.en: So the player may read the list as a manager, then receive a superior's notice: meets expectations, which is corporate for do not ask about a raise.

chapters.title_zh: OKR负责抬头看路，KPI负责低头看刀
chapters.title_en: OKR LOOKS AT THE HORIZON; KPI CHECKS THE BLADE

capture.shot: 录目标责任书或政策卡、KPI分项提示、两名官员因总督效率/贤能/忠诚/罪行与任务证据得到不同分数。

cues.zh: 这不是把KPI三个字贴在总督效率上就收工。系统把业绩、贤能、成长、忠诚、罪行、派系和管理信号拆成证据。
cues.en: This is not a KPI label pasted onto governor efficiency. Delivery, merit, growth, loyalty, crime, factions, and management signals become evidence.

cues.zh: OKR决定你宣称要改变什么，KPI记录你真的交付了什么。挑战目标失败，可以留下探索价值；保守目标全绿，也可能只是把门槛埋进地板。
cues.en: OKR states what you meant to change; KPI records what actually shipped. A failed stretch goal may teach, while an easy green target may hide the bar underground.

cues.zh: 最要命的是，分数不是结论，只是你进入校准会时能带上桌的弹药。数据很客观，解释数据的人更客观。
cues.en: The score is not the verdict. It is merely the ammunition you bring into calibration. Data is objective; the person interpreting it is somehow even more objective.

chapters.title_zh: 强制分布：不是问有没有C，是问C姓什么
chapters.title_en: FORCED DISTRIBUTION: NOT WHETHER THERE IS A BOTTOM RATING, BUT WHO OWNS IT

capture.shot: 同一考核组至少十人，录唯一名次、3.75/3.5/3.25分档、末位配额及边界两人的前后对比。

cues.zh: 361的灵魂是强制分布：少数3.75，多数3.5，末位3.25。大家都完成目标，也不妨碍有人必须解释自己为什么不够优秀。
cues.en: The soul of 361 is forced distribution: a few 3.75s, most 3.5s, and a bottom 3.25. Everyone may deliver, yet someone must explain why they were not excellent enough.

cues.zh: 排名采用固定序位，平分也不会全员并列第一、集体冲进3.75。毕竟真正的大厂从不允许数学破坏组织目标。
cues.en: Ranks use a stable unique order. A tie cannot make everyone number one and flood 3.75, because mathematics must never obstruct an organizational target.

cues.zh: 小团队可能没有末位名额；大团队则要面对边界。你不是在挑坏人，你是在决定哪位好人今年看起来最像坏人。
cues.en: A small team may have no bottom quota; a large team has a boundary. You are not selecting a bad official, only the good official who looks most expendable this year.

chapters.title_zh: 校准会：用最礼貌的语气，讨论最不礼貌的名额

capture.shot: 录自动排名、公示前校准窗口、保护边界官员与将另一人压入3.25的选择，以及曝光/威信/好感代价。

cues.zh: 自动排名之后、正式发榜之前，玩家可以进入校准。这里不是改一个数字，而是把配额、证据、人情和政敌放进同一口锅。
cues.en: After automatic ranking and before publication comes calibration, where quota, evidence, favors, and political enemies all enter the same pot.

cues.zh: 你可以保一个边界同僚，也可以为了凑C把另一个人踩下去；每次动手脚都留下理由、受益者和潜在曝光。
cues.en: You may protect one boundary colleague or push another down to fill the bottom slot. Every move records its reason, beneficiary, and exposure risk.

cues.zh: 校准真正有趣的地方，是它把抽象制度变成具体关系：今天你护的人，明天可能替你说话；今天你背的锅，明年会长出利息。
cues.en: Calibration turns policy into relationships. The person you protect may defend you tomorrow; the blame you accept today compounds by next year.

chapters.title_zh: 背靠背互评：当面哥俩好，匿名一星少不了
chapters.title_en: BACK-TO-BACK PEER REVIEW: FRIENDS IN PUBLIC, ONE STAR IN PRIVATE

status.zh: 待录互评与向上管理实机

capture.shot: 录背靠背邀评/举荐/攻讦交互、贡献与可见度差异，并让同一人选择做实事或向上汇报。

cues.zh: 背靠背互评把同僚关系变成匿名战场。你可以真诚举荐、谨慎保留，也可以写出那句经典评价：合作意识仍有提升空间。
cues.en: Back-to-back peer review turns collegial relations into an anonymous arena: endorse, hedge, or write the classic line that collaboration still has room to grow.

cues.zh: 互评不是随机加减分。利益冲突、共同项目、评价可信度和后来被事实打脸，都会回头结算。造谣可以赢一季，也可能输掉三年。
cues.en: Peer review is not random score noise. Conflicts, shared projects, reviewer credibility, and later facts all settle the account. A lie may win one season and lose three years.

cues.zh: 向上管理也不是纯好感按钮。你花时间让上司看见成果，就少一点时间做成果；完全不汇报，又会发现功劳自动进入最会讲故事的人名下。
cues.en: Managing up is not a simple opinion button. Time spent making work visible is time not doing it, yet silence lets the best storyteller inherit the credit.

chapters.title_zh: 京察：活动免费，不办的代价比较贵
chapters.title_en: JINGCHA: FREE TO HOLD, EXPENSIVE TO SKIP

capture.shot: 录定期京察弹窗、默认举办路径、明确不花钱、拒绝选项，以及拒办后直属上司好感和下一轮KPI重大扣分理由。

cues.zh: 京察是定期弹出的半强制活动，举办本身不花钱。系统默认你应该办，因为评价下属不是领导的兴趣爱好，是岗位说明书。
cues.en: Jingcha is a periodic semi-mandatory activity and costs nothing to hold. Reviewing subordinates is not a leadership hobby; it is the job description.

cues.zh: 玩家当然可以说不。自由一直都在，只是你的直属上司也会自由地降低好感，并把拒办写进下一次绩效理由。
cues.en: The player may refuse. Freedom remains, while the direct superior remains free to lose opinion and record refusal as a major reason in the next review.

cues.zh: 而且这笔账绑定发令上司，不会换个老板就被陌生人捡去扣分。坏消息有责任人，好消息是流程终于有责任人。
cues.en: That reason is bound to the superior who issued it; a new boss cannot consume an old refusal. The bad news has an owner, which is also the good news.

chapters.title_zh: 考核榜与告身：终于有人告诉你到底排第几
chapters.title_en: SCOREBOARD AND RECEIPT: SOMEONE FINALLY TELLS YOU YOUR RANK

capture.shot: 录右上角考核榜三页：我主持的榜、上司给我的结果、制度驾驶舱；特写个人档位、KPI、名次、连续次数与PIP/晋升状态。

cues.zh: 考核榜不是一条转瞬即逝的通知。每轮榜单冻结人物、官职、KPI、价值观分、名次、档位、连续次数和后续状态。
cues.en: The scoreboard is not a disposable toast. Each cycle freezes the official, office, KPI, values, rank, grade, streak, and follow-up state.

cues.zh: 你主持考核时看整张团队榜；你被上司考核时收到独立告身，直接写明上司是谁、你拿多少分、同组第几、绩效几档。
cues.en: Managers see the full team board. When your superior rates you, a separate receipt names the superior, your score, cohort rank, and grade.

cues.zh: 旧榜不会因为人员调动或下轮打分偷偷漂移。过去的3.25会忠诚地留在过去，像一张永远不会自动撤回的群聊截图。
cues.en: Old boards do not drift after transfers or later reviews. A past 3.25 stays in the past, like a group-chat screenshot that never unsends itself.

chapters.title_zh: 3.25不是表情包：国库、金币、俸禄一起有感觉
chapters.title_en: 3.25 IS NOT A MEME: TREASURY, GOLD, AND SALARY ALL FEEL IT

capture.shot: 同屏记录结算前后地方国库、个人金币、俸禄/merit与modifier；分别展示3.75、3.5、3.25，并保存精确罚没回执。

cues.zh: 档位必须落到资源上才有手感。3.75进入晋升和奖励通道，3.5保住正常节奏，3.25则启动真正的改进成本。
cues.en: Grades need resource consequences. A 3.75 opens reward and promotion lanes, 3.5 keeps the normal cadence, and 3.25 starts a real improvement cost.

cues.zh: 3.25同时影响地方国库、个人金币和一年俸禄。组织说这是共同承担，翻译一下就是：团队预算和你钱包都要参加复盘。
cues.en: A 3.25 hits the local treasury, personal gold, and one year of salary. Shared accountability means both the team budget and your wallet attend the retrospective.

cues.zh: 罚没会保存精确金额和本轮编号。如果申诉改判，退的是这一次实际扣的钱，不是系统心情好随手发一张代金券。
cues.en: The penalty records exact amounts and review serial. A successful appeal refunds what this cycle actually took, not a goodwill coupon invented afterward.

chapters.title_zh: PIP与末位：给你改进机会，也给上司腾椅子的机会
chapters.title_en: PIP AND THE BOTTOM: A CHANCE TO IMPROVE, AND A CHANCE TO FREE YOUR CHAIR

capture.shot: 录首次3.25进入PIP、目标/支持选择、下轮改善与失败对照；再录连续两次后夺爵、致仕、降岗、留观四类末位处置。

cues.zh: 第一次3.25进入PIP，也就是绩效改进计划。它不是必败倒计时：目标、期限、支持预算和中期检查都能改变结果。
cues.en: The first 3.25 enters PIP, a performance improvement plan. It is not a scripted death clock: goals, support, deadlines, and midpoints can change the result.

cues.zh: 经理可以给资源，也可以只给指标不给资源；后者省下眼前成本，却会把支持缺位记到经理自己的组织绩效。
cues.en: A manager may fund support or provide targets without resources. The latter saves money now, but missing support returns in the manager's own performance.

cues.zh: 连续两次末位才进入淘汰阶梯：夺爵、致仕、降岗留用或再观察。所谓毕业答辩，有人毕业，有人的岗位毕业。
cues.en: Two consecutive bottom ratings enter the exit ladder: title removal, retirement, demotion, or another year. In the final review, someone graduates; sometimes the position graduates without them.

chapters.title_zh: 晋升包与HC：你证明自己配得上，组织证明它没有坑
chapters.title_en: PROMOTION PACKET AND HEADCOUNT: YOU PROVE MERIT; THE ORG PROVES A SLOT EXISTS

capture.shot: 录高绩效官员形成晋升包、跨部门答辩、成功/延期；再录软HC余额、增编答辩、冻结与岗位空缺。

cues.zh: 高绩效不会自动升官，而是生成晋升包：历史结果、能力证据、跨部门贡献和风险说明，一样不少地拿去答辩。
cues.en: High performance does not auto-promote. It creates a promotion packet: results, capability evidence, cross-team contribution, and risks for a real defense.

cues.zh: 然后轮到HC，也就是headcount编制。你可以完全够格，岗位也可以完全不存在；个人优秀与组织没坑，是两套独立条件。
cues.en: Then comes HC, the headcount slot. You may be fully qualified while the job fully does not exist; personal excellence and organizational vacancy are separate conditions.

cues.zh: 经理能申请增编、冻结名额、内部转岗或继续让现团队加班填坑。每个选择都影响预算、士气、交付和下一次经理考核。
cues.en: Managers may request headcount, freeze a slot, transfer internally, or keep filling the gap with overtime. Each choice changes budget, morale, delivery, and their next review.

chapters.title_zh: 跨部门抢功：项目成功了，突然每个人都是核心贡献者
chapters.title_en: CROSS-TEAM CREDIT: THE PROJECT SHIPPED, SO EVERYONE WAS APPARENTLY ESSENTIAL

capture.shot: 录跨部门成果/依赖账本、贡献与可见度双账、抢功/甩锅选择及仲裁结果；至少一组真实贡献低但汇报强的对照。

cues.zh: 跨部门项目有两本账：谁真正贡献，谁被组织看见。它们可以重合，也可以像年会节目和实际工作一样毫无关系。
cues.en: Cross-team work keeps two ledgers: actual contribution and organizational visibility. They may overlap, or relate like the annual gala and actual delivery.

cues.zh: 当成果落地，官员可以认领credit、共享功劳、抢功或把延期甩给依赖方。系统冻结项目、责任和时间线，不靠随机事件凭空判案。
cues.en: When work ships, officials may claim credit, share it, steal it, or blame a dependency. Project, responsibility, and timeline are frozen instead of invented by a random event.

cues.zh: 抢功成功会提高可见度，却积累信任债；甩锅短期保分，证据翻案后则同时损失协作与评价可信度。故事讲得好，也要经得起回放。
cues.en: Credit theft raises visibility but builds trust debt. Blame may protect a score until evidence reverses it and damages collaboration plus reviewer credibility. The story must survive replay.

chapters.title_zh: 绩效申诉：不是掀桌，是要求把桌上的账重新加一遍
chapters.title_en: PERFORMANCE APPEAL: NOT FLIPPING THE TABLE, JUST RECOUNTING WHAT IS ON IT

capture.shot: 录玩家收到3.25后发起申诉、证据复核、维持与改判两路；改判同步退款、修榜，并展示申诉不加重和反报复观察。

cues.zh: 被打3.25后，玩家可以认命、摆烂、奋发，也可以正式申诉。申诉消耗政治资源，但要求复核证据、程序和配额边界。
cues.en: After a 3.25, the player may accept, disengage, improve, or file a formal appeal. Appeal costs political capital but rechecks evidence, procedure, and quota boundaries.

cues.zh: 改判会同步修正榜单、连续次数和精确罚没；复核只能维持或减轻原处理，不能因为你敢申诉就顺手再加一刀。
cues.en: A reversal updates the scoreboard, streak, and exact penalty. Review may maintain or reduce the decision; it cannot punish you merely for appealing.

cues.zh: 如果发现新的独立造假，要另开新案、重新举证。程序正义不是让坏人免疫，而是禁止领导在原工单里偷偷追加需求。
cues.en: Independent new fraud requires a new case and evidence. Due process does not grant immunity; it stops a manager from quietly adding scope to the original ticket.

chapters.title_zh: 不只一个考核季：361张政策卡把组织慢慢养成怪物
chapters.title_en: BEYOND ONE REVIEW: 361 POLICY CARDS GROW AN ORGANIZATION OVER TIME

status.zh: 待录政策卡与驾驶舱实机

capture.shot: 录连续政策卡选择、制度驾驶舱14项组织账本和年度批处理；快速展示多张不同机制，不逐张弹完361张。

cues.zh: 核心考核之外，还有整整361张机制卡。它们不是361个孤立弹窗，而是围绕证据、信任、交付、稳定、人才、HC和倦怠共享账本。
cues.en: Beyond the core review are 361 mechanism cards. They are not 361 disconnected pop-ups; they share ledgers for evidence, trust, delivery, stability, talent, HC, and burnout.

cues.zh: 玩家每次在真实取舍里选方向：严控流程还是相信团队，短期交付还是偿还技术债，冻结编制还是承认目标必须缩水。
cues.en: Each card asks for a real tradeoff: control or trust, near-term delivery or technical debt, frozen headcount or an honest reduction in scope.

cues.zh: AI经理按性格和组织气候批量处理，玩家只在值得决策时被打断。目标不是每天收三百六十一封邮件，而是十年后发现制度已经长成你的形状。
cues.en: AI managers batch decisions through personality and climate; players are interrupted only for meaningful choices. The goal is not 361 daily emails, but an institution shaped by ten years of decisions.

chapters.title_zh: 一轮完整玩法：定目标、交证据、互评、校准、发榜、申诉、兑现
chapters.title_en: THE FULL LOOP: TARGETS, EVIDENCE, PEERS, CALIBRATION, BOARD, APPEAL, CONSEQUENCE

capture.shot: 用同一存档同一考核轮串起目标、证据、背靠背、校准、榜单、个人告身、3.25处罚、申诉退款或PIP后续；保留连续录像与同run证据。

cues.zh: 真正的核心不是任何一个热词，而是一整轮因果链：年初定目标，中途积证据，同僚背靠背，经理校准，正式发榜。
cues.en: The core is not any buzzword but one causal loop: set targets, accumulate evidence, collect peer review, calibrate, and publish the board.

cues.zh: 然后奖励、罚没、晋升、PIP、末位和申诉继续改变人物关系与组织资源；下轮考核会读取这些后果，而不是世界刷新后集体失忆。
cues.en: Rewards, penalties, promotion, PIP, bottom action, and appeal then reshape relationships and resources. The next cycle reads those consequences instead of forgetting them.

cues.zh: 所以你做的不是一份古代人力资源表格。你是在经营一个会记仇、会抢功、会画饼，也偶尔真的能把事情做成的天朝大厂。
cues.en: You are not managing an ancient HR spreadsheet. You are running an imperial megacorp that remembers grudges, steals credit, sells dreams, and occasionally ships something.

chapters.title_zh: 先看证据，再喊牛：宣传片也要过绩效
chapters.title_en: EVIDENCE BEFORE HYPE: EVEN THE PROMO HAS A PERFORMANCE REVIEW
body_zh: 同轮素材绑定同一证据
最终成片必须短于20分钟
body_en: Same-cycle footage binds to the same run
Final duration must remain under twenty minutes

cues.zh: 现在这份工程首先是一版可调整的宣传脚本和占位分镜。画面写着待实录，就是真的待实录，不拿漂亮卡片冒充CK3已经跑通。
cues.en: This project begins as an editable script and placeholder animatic. If a frame says capture pending, it is pending; a polished card is never passed off as live CK3.

cues.zh: 正式版会把每个核心镜头绑定到同一轮实机证据，检查时长、编码、字幕安全区、中文配音和开场无读条。
cues.en: The final cut will bind core shots to same-cycle evidence and validate duration, codecs, subtitle safety, Chinese narration, and an opening without loading.

cues.zh: 毕竟一个讲绩效的mod，如果宣传片自己没有验收、没有证据、还偷偷超时二十分钟，那它拿3.25一点也不冤。
cues.en: A performance mod whose own promo lacks acceptance, evidence, or the twenty-minute limit would deserve its 3.25.

chapters.title_zh: 来吧，给天下打分——然后等天下给你打分
chapters.title_en: RATE THE REALM—THEN WAIT FOR THE REALM TO RATE YOU

cues.zh: 你可以做一个证据充分、愿意护人的好领导，也可以把所有人卷到只剩漂亮报表；两条路都能走，只是账会一直记着。
cues.en: You may lead with evidence and protection, or grind everyone down until only beautiful reports remain. Both paths exist, and the ledger remembers both.

cues.zh: 《天朝特色361制官员绩效考核》：请开始管理你的直属官员，并准备好在上司面前解释，为什么你的管理方式符合预期。
cues.en: ZhongGuo 361 Style: begin managing your direct officials, then prepare to explain to your superior why your management style meets expectations.

cues.zh: 祝各位年年3.75。至于名额够不够——这不是我的问题，这是下一场校准会的议题。
cues.en: May you earn 3.75 every year. Whether the quota allows it is not my problem; that belongs to the next calibration meeting.
